reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Concentration-matrix kinetics, recovery, structural techniques and detergent challenge.

checks.reason: No complete prospective known-product positive, enzyme/substrate-free negative and matched procedural control design with each role; named generic artifact checks or vehicle alone are insufficient.
No plan to consult prior Methods/supplements or validated protocols and check transfer before execution.
No detector/product reference calibration with acceptance criterion and failed-calibration action.
Units and kinetic parameters are reported, but the proposed rate endpoint lacks baseline correction and weak/saturated/missing-value rules.

checks.quote: either cannot form or is catalytically dead
checks.reason: Three errors: a catalytically dead ESI complex generally permits uncompetitive/mixed rather than pure competitive inhibition; Km is not necessarily substrate affinity; visual Km values 25/75 materially overread the supplied 20/60. Related consequences of each proposition are charged once.

checks.quote: will confirm if the competitive model holds universally
checks.reason: A finite concentration matrix cannot establish universal validity outside tested conditions.

checks.quote: functional states rather than physical locations
checks.reason: Correct main parameter direction, kinetic/site distinction and conditional synthetic framing, with alternative mechanisms and proposed tests in the requested format.
